events.summary:
At 440 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Akela, moving north at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Akela and Deming Ranchettes.

This includes Interstate 10 in New Mexico between mile markers 97 and
106.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central El Paso County in western Texas...

* WHEN...Until 1045 PM MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry arroyos.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 438 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen.
- Additional rainfall of up to 0.5 inches is expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Far East El Paso and Socorro.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.summary:
* WHAT...Water levels of 2.5 to 3.5 feet above the normal high
tide expected during the Thursday and Friday high tides.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast, specifically Hooper Bay.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Beach property and lowest buildings may be impacted.
Multiple high tide cycles above normal may lead to localized
beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels of around 1 to 3 feet above
the normal high tide line are expected along the rest of the
Yukon Delta Coast.

expected. For the Gale Warning, east winds 35 to 45 kt with
gusts up to 65 kt and seas 13 to 18 ft expected. For the Storm
Warning, east winds 40 to 50 kt with gusts up to 65 kt and
seas 14 to 19 ft expected.

* WHERE...Icy Cape to Cape Suckling out to 15 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 10 PM this evening

AKDT Friday. For the Storm Warning, from 10 PM Friday to 4 AM
AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Storm force winds and hazardous seas will capsize or
damage vessels and reduce visibility.
